verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a note-taking and knowledge-base app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Logseq shipping a native AI assistant that answers questions, summarizes, or drafts from the user's notes, or any controls over what data such an assistant sees. The docs cover only queries, third-party plugins and a local HTTP API, and the one community AI mention is about external tools (Claude/codex) editing pages, not a built-in feature.
